checks.tagline_fit: all 9 variants fit two lines (375-440 pt)
checks.blurb_fit: all 6 blurbs fit (2-3 lines or 3-3); tongatapu 'Jun-Oct', vavau 'Jul-Oct'
checks.whyVisit: all start with action verbs; none promises a passing state (whale and wreck items are seasonal or permanent)

tongatapu.text: Main island, ~260 km2, capital Nukuʻalofa, ~70% of population; monarchy never colonised
Haʻamonga ʻa Maui c.1200 AD; Muʻa langi tombs of Tuʻi Tonga
South coast blowholes (Mapuʻa ʻa Vaea) and Hufangalupe land bridge

tongatapu.fix: Talamahu Market is described only as the main market, not daily. Drop 'daily' ('a central market').

tongatapu.text: Feast and dance shows, Sunday church singing, island-resort ferries and Pangaimotu wreck snorkel
Tip: Sunday rest day; driving permit from Police HQ/rental agencies, drive left, 50 km/h; cash/ATMs in Nukuʻalofa
Tip: buses from seafront, no timetable, unreliable after ~15:30, flag down
Tip: 'Cover up away from the resort beaches. Visitors have been arrested for walking around topless.'
tongatapu.fix: Source says only 'dress modestly... some people (usually from cruise liners) have been arrested for walking around topless'; 'away from the resort beaches' is added. Use: 'Dress modestly in towns and villages. Some cruise visitors have been arrested for walking around topless.' Source is Wikivoyage (single source); tourism board backs 'modest dress appreciated, especially in villages'.
Whale season is July-Oct (tourism board) or Jun-Nov (Wikivoyage); 'from July' is safe.

vavau.text: >50 islands ~250 km north of Tongatapu, Neiafu on ʻUtu Vavaʻu

vavau.fix: Wikivoyage Tonga page says 'about 500'; if unsure write 'about 500'.

vavau.text: Whales give birth in sheltered waters; swim with them; licensed operators only; Jul-Oct
Vanilla major producer; Mt Talau trail; Swallows/Mariner's caves; marlin/sailfish game fishing
Tip: Lulutai Airlines flies Tongatapu to Vavaʻu, only domestic airline, ferry also runs
vavau.source: https://www.tongatourism.travel/plan/helpful-info; https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Vava'u (MV ʻOtuangaʻafa ferry); https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/%CA%BBEua ('Vava'u ... Flights are from Tongatapu')
vavau.fix: Tourism board names Lulutai as sole domestic carrier linking Tongatapu with outer islands; the Vavaʻu route itself is from Wikivoyage. No schedule or frequency claimed: fine.

vavau.text: Tip: Sunday closures, modest dress, cash on outer islands; 'cards not widely taken'

vavau.fix: Wikivoyage widens to Jun-Nov; Jul-Oct is the stricter supported range.

eua-island.text: 87 km2, non-volcanic, oldest island, 312 m high, cliffs/caves/sinkholes/rainforest
Tonga's only forest national park; Big Ovava Tree 800+ years; red shining parrot; stargazing

eua-island.fix: Wikivoyage Tongatapu says 'eight-minute' and ferry can take far longer in bad weather; 'check the schedule' covers it.

eua-island.text: Tip: 'Trails run past cliffs and sinkholes, so keep to well-marked paths'
eua-island.fix: Tourism board says trails are 'well-marked' but gives no hazard advice; researcher flagged it unverified. Acceptable only as plain advice; better replace with the sourced 'rent a car, taxi or bus; cash essential'.

eua-island.text: Tip: car/taxi/local buses on Tongatapu and ʻEua; cash; Sunday closures
bestMonths 6-10; humpbacks pass close to shore
